turns.assessment: All degraded services traverse the S03–S24 lightpath, while the amplifiers, channel monitors, and far-end interface show no optical change. The unchanged suite of receiver telemetry at trx.och68.a despite neighbouring variation is most consistent with frozen/invalid monitoring from a failed line-interface card, which would also interrupt all traffic aggregated on that interface. Optical-path faults and a transmitter-only failure are strongly contradicted by the unchanged power, OSNR, BER, and amplifier measurements.

proposals.rationale: A card failure explains both the locally static monitoring and degradation of all services using och68 between S03 and S24. The documented mode explicitly masks traffic alarms and leaves receiver monitoring without valid updates.
A switch failure at S24 could interrupt multiple ODUs without changing optical measurements, but it does not specifically explain why trx.och68.a telemetry became static at onset.
